extra_vocab.zh: 碳粉（影印機、雷射印表機用）
extra_vocab.en: the powder used in printers and copy machines to make words and pictures
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇指辦公室影印機與印表機消耗的碳粉，訂購量今年上升近兩成。多益常見於辦公用品採購與設備維護，如 toner cartridge（碳粉匣）。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: toner 指碳粉時通常是不可數名詞，不說 a toner；要計數時用 a toner cartridge、two cartridges of toner。

example.en: Please store the spare toner cartridge in the supply room.
example.zh: 請把備用的碳粉匣放在庫房。

example.en: The printer ran out of toner in the middle of the job.
example.zh: 印表機在列印途中碳粉用完了。

example.en: A technician will replace the toner when the light turns red.
example.zh: 指示燈變紅時，技術人員會更換碳粉。

example.en: The copier is low on toner, so please order more.
example.zh: 影印機的碳粉快沒了，請多訂一些。

examples.en: Toner is one of our biggest monthly office expenses.
examples.zh: 碳粉是我們每月最大的辦公室開銷之一。

examples.en: Faded text usually means the printer needs fresh toner.
examples.zh: 文字變淡通常表示印表機需要新的碳粉。

examples.en: Employees should report any toner spills to the facilities team.
examples.zh: 員工發現碳粉灑出時，應通報總務團隊。

confusable.diff: 拼法接近，但 tone 是「語氣、音調」，和印表機無關。

example.en: Please use a polite tone when writing to clients.
example.zh: 寫信給客戶時請使用有禮貌的語氣。

similar.diff: ink 是液態墨水，用於噴墨印表機；toner 是粉末，用於雷射印表機和影印機。

example.en: We switched to cheaper ink for the small office printer.
example.zh: 我們幫小型辦公室的印表機換成較便宜的墨水。

example.en: Replace the empty cartridge with a new one.
example.zh: 請用新的匣子換掉空的那個。

example.en: The printer on the third floor is out of order.
example.zh: 三樓的印表機故障了。

example.en: The copier jams whenever we use thick paper.
example.zh: 只要用厚紙，影印機就會卡紙。

extra_vocab.en: a box made of thick paper, used for holding or moving goods
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇 cartons of copy paper 指一箱箱的影印紙，是共用辦公用品的計量單位。多益常見於採購、倉儲和運送，如 a carton of。

example.en: Please move the cartons to the storage room before noon.
example.zh: 請在中午前把這些紙箱搬到儲藏室。

example.en: We ordered a carton of printer paper for the new office.
example.zh: 我們為新辦公室訂了一箱影印紙。

example.en: Each cardboard carton holds twelve bottles of water.
example.zh: 每個硬紙箱可裝十二瓶水。

example.en: Keep unused items in a sealed carton to protect them from dust.
example.zh: 未使用的物品請放在封好的紙箱裡，以免沾灰塵。

examples.en: The warehouse stacks the cartons by size and delivery date.
examples.zh: 倉庫依大小和送貨日期堆放紙箱。

examples.en: Two cartons were damaged during shipping, so we filed a claim.
examples.zh: 有兩個紙箱在運送途中受損，所以我們提出了索賠。

examples.en: The supplier offers a discount if we buy ten cartons.
examples.zh: 如果我們買十箱，供應商就給折扣。

confusable.diff: 拼法很像，但 cartoon 是「卡通、漫畫」，不是紙箱。

example.en: The ad campaign features a cartoon character for children.
example.zh: 這次廣告活動以給小朋友的卡通角色為主角。

similar.diff: box 是各種盒子、箱子的通稱；carton 多指紙製、用來裝貨品或運送的箱盒。

example.en: Please put the documents in a box and label it.
example.zh: 請把文件放進箱子並貼上標籤。

similar.diff: case 常指整批商品的一箱（如一箱十二瓶酒）；carton 是紙箱本身。

example.en: The wine arrived in a case of twelve bottles.
example.zh: 這批酒以一箱十二瓶的方式送達。

example.en: A package arrived at the front desk this morning.
example.zh: 今天早上有一個包裹送到櫃檯。

example.en: The next shipment of paper will arrive on Tuesday.
example.zh: 下一批紙張會在星期二到。

example.en: Our warehouse is located near the main highway.
example.zh: 我們的倉庫位在主要公路附近。

senses.en: a large paper box used for holding or moving goods

example.en: Each carton of copy paper weighs about twenty kilograms.
example.zh: 每箱影印紙大約重二十公斤。

senses.en: a small paper or plastic container for food or drink
senses.distinguish: 前面接 milk、juice、eggs 時，指的是這種紙盒容器。

example.en: She grabbed a carton of milk from the office fridge.
example.zh: 她從辦公室冰箱拿了一盒牛奶。

extra_vocab.en: the amount of something that is used
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇 paper consumption 指紙張的使用量今年上升近兩成，是設置管理員的原因。多益常見於能源、材料、成本控管的報告，強調資源被用掉的量。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: consumption 是不可數名詞，不加 a 或 s；後面接 of 表示「…的消耗量」，如 the consumption of paper。

example.en: The new lights lowered our energy consumption by fifteen percent.
example.zh: 新的燈具讓我們的能源消耗降低了百分之十五。

example.en: Employees were asked to reduce consumption of bottled water.
example.zh: 員工被要求減少瓶裝水的使用量。

example.en: This delivery truck has very low fuel consumption.
example.zh: 這輛送貨卡車的燃料消耗很低。

example.en: The consumption of electricity rises sharply in summer.
example.zh: 夏季的用電量會大幅上升。

examples.en: Monthly consumption is tracked on a shared spreadsheet.
examples.zh: 每月的消耗量記錄在共用的試算表上。

examples.en: Rising consumption of raw materials is pushing up our costs.
examples.zh: 原料消耗量上升正在推高我們的成本。

examples.en: Coffee consumption among young adults has grown steadily over five years.
examples.zh: 年輕人的咖啡消費量在五年間穩定成長。

confusable.diff: 字尾 -sumption 很像，但 assumption 是「假設」，不是消耗。

example.en: The forecast is based on a simple assumption about prices.
example.zh: 這份預測是根據對價格的簡單假設。

similar.diff: usage 指使用的情況或量，較中性（資料、網路、設備）；consumption 強調資源被用掉。

example.en: Our data usage doubled after the new software launch.
example.zh: 新軟體上線後，我們的資料使用量增加了一倍。

similar.diff: expenditure 指金錢的支出；consumption 指資源或物品的消耗量。

example.en: Total expenditure on supplies rose last quarter.
example.zh: 上一季的耗材總支出增加了。

example.en: Demand for recycled paper has grown this year.
example.zh: 今年對再生紙的需求增加了。

example.en: Our supply of copy paper will last two more weeks.
example.zh: 我們的影印紙存量還能用兩週。

example.en: Double-sided printing helps reduce paper waste in the office.
example.zh: 雙面列印有助於減少辦公室的紙張浪費。

derived.link: consume 是詞幹，把 -ume 改成 -umption 變成名詞「消耗」，像 assume → assumption
consume + -able，「可以被用掉的東西」，像 affordable、reusable

extra_vocab.en: in a way that is easy and saves time or effort
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇 can conveniently handle these duties during regular working hours，指在正常上班時間內就能順利處理這些工作，不需要加班。多益常見 conveniently located（位置便利），語氣偏正面、帶推薦意味。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: conveniently located 後面常接 near、close to 或 in the center of；located 前面要用副詞 conveniently，不是形容詞 convenient。

example.en: The hotel is conveniently located near the convention center.
example.zh: 這間飯店位置便利，就在會議中心附近。

example.en: Recycling bins are conveniently placed on every floor.
example.zh: 每一層樓都有擺放在方便處的回收桶。

example.en: Application forms are conveniently available on our website.
example.zh: 申請表可以方便地在我們的網站上取得。

examples.en: Customers can conveniently pay their bills through the mobile app.
examples.zh: 顧客可以透過手機應用程式方便地付帳單。

examples.en: Staff can conveniently print documents from any floor of the building.
examples.zh: 員工可以在大樓任何一層方便地列印文件。

examples.en: You may conveniently reschedule your appointment online at any time.
examples.zh: 您可以隨時在線上方便地重新安排預約。

confusable.diff: 意思相近，但 convenient 是形容詞「方便的」。
confusable.usage: convenient 修飾名詞（a convenient time）；conveniently 是副詞，修飾動詞或 located、placed 等分詞。

example.en: Please choose a convenient time for the interview.
example.zh: 請選一個方便的面試時間。

similar.diff: easily 強調不費力、很容易；conveniently 強調方便、省時省事。

example.en: Files can be easily shared with the whole team.
example.zh: 檔案可以輕鬆分享給整個團隊。

similar.diff: readily 指「隨時、現成地」，常搭配 available；conveniently 強調位置或方式方便。

example.en: Replacement parts are readily available in our warehouse.
example.zh: 替換零件在我們的倉庫裡隨時都有。

example.en: The new system lets us handle orders efficiently.
example.zh: 新系統讓我們能有效率地處理訂單。

example.en: Please reply promptly so we can confirm the booking.
example.zh: 請盡快回覆，我們才能確認預訂。

derived.link: convenient 是詞幹，加 -ly 變成副詞 conveniently，像 recent → recently
convenient 把 -t 改成 -ce 變名詞，像 absent → absence
in- + convenience，「不方便」，像 sorry for the inconvenience（抱歉造成不便）

extra_vocab.en: a small tool that puts metal pins through paper to hold it together
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇是共用辦公用品的例子之一（staplers and cartons of copy paper）。多益常見於辦公用品採購、庫房管理和公告，常與 staples（釘書針）一起出現。

example.en: Each department received two new staplers this month.
example.zh: 每個部門這個月都收到兩台新的釘書機。

example.en: The print shop bought an electric stapler for thick reports.
example.zh: 輸出店買了一台電動釘書機來裝訂厚的報告。

example.en: Could I borrow a stapler from your desk for a moment?
example.zh: 我可以跟你借一下桌上的釘書機嗎？

example.en: A heavy-duty stapler can bind up to fifty pages.
example.zh: 重型釘書機可以裝訂多達五十頁。

examples.en: The stapler is out of staples, so please refill it.
examples.zh: 釘書機沒有釘書針了，請補充一下。

examples.en: We need to order staplers, folders, and highlighters this week.
examples.zh: 我們這週需要訂購釘書機、資料夾和螢光筆。

examples.en: Please return the stapler to the supply room after you use it.
examples.zh: 用完釘書機後，請把它放回庫房。

confusable.diff: 拼法有點像，但 stable 是「穩定的」，是形容詞。

example.en: The company has remained financially stable for ten years.
example.zh: 這家公司十年來財務一直很穩定。

similar.diff: paper clip 是迴紋針，可以拆下且不會在紙上留洞；stapler 是用釘書針固定。

example.en: Attach the receipt to the form with a paper clip.
example.zh: 請用迴紋針把收據夾在表格上。

example.en: Please put the signed contract in the blue folder.
example.zh: 請把簽好的合約放進藍色資料夾。

example.en: She used a yellow highlighter to mark the key figures.
example.zh: 她用黃色螢光筆標出重要數字。

example.en: Please seal the envelope before you leave it at reception.
example.zh: 留在櫃檯前，請先把信封封好。

derived.link: staple 是詞幹（釘）；加 -r（-er）變成做這件事的工具，像 printer、copier
